sio2_quenching_3_subtask_structure_retri.name: SiO2 Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_structure_retri.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 (or a molten restart) and convert it to LAMMPS data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_quenching_3_subtask_potential_file.name: SiO2 Potential File for Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.name: SiO2 NPT Quenching - Level 3
sio2_quenching_3_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible alpha quartz SiO2 structure and Tersoff potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching of the system and return the glass transition temperature (Tg) in Kelvin.
